dataset: Labuhn 2017 external screen library mapped to hg19 (canonical contigs, valid NGG loci)
interpretation: Multi-copy guides deplete more than unique-locus guides in both lines (KBM7 MWU p=0.023; HL60 n.s. but extreme-copy subset clearly elevated: 1.84 vs 1.25 mean). Consistent with multi-locus cutting toxicity/confounding in essentiality screens; modest effect sizes; two lines tested without multiplicity correction.
